mapper.sql: select r.id, r.tenant_id as tenantId, t.company_name as tenantName, r.policy_id as policyId, r.policy_no as policyNo, r.product_id as productId, r.product_name as productName, r.premium, r.commission_base as commissionBase, r.sales_user_id as salesUserId, r.sales_amount as salesAmount, r.team_user_id as teamUserId, r.team_amount as teamAmount, r.project_user_id as projectUserId, r.project_amount as projectAmount, r.calc_strategy as calcStrategy, r.status, r.version, r.del_flag as delFlag, r.create_time as createTime, r.sales_ratio as salesRatio, r.team_ratio as teamRatio, r.project_ratio as projectRatio, r.sales_user_name as salesUserName, r.team_user_name as teamUserName, r.project_user_name as projectUserName, r.sales_status as salesStatus, r.team_status as teamStatus, r.project_status as projectStatus from biz_commission_record r left join sys_tenant t on t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalAmount,
IFNULL(SUM( CASE
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{queryMonth}
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
THEN (CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS monthAmount
FROM biz_commission_record WHERE status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' AND ( (sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1) OR (team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1) OR (project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1) )

SELECT policy_no AS policyNo, product_name as productName, commission_base AS commissionBase, status AS status, create_time AS createTime,
(CASE WHEN sales_status = 1 THEN sales_ratio ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_ratio ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_ratio ELSE 0 END) AS ratio,
(CASE WHEN sales_status = 1 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount
team_ratio AS ratio, team_amount AS amount
project_ratio AS ratio, project_amount AS amount
FROM biz_commission_record WHERE status = 0 AND del_flag = '0'
AND sales_user_id = #{userId} AND ( sales_status = 1 OR (team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1) OR (project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1) )
AND team_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_user_id != #{userId} AND team_status = 1
AND project_user_id = #{userId} AND team_user_id != #{userId} AND sales_user_id != #{userId} AND project_status = 1
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{bo.queryMonth}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
